desc: Reduce condition to ord_M(A) = N and design multi-prime construction (factor N into prime powers, choose distinct primes r_i ≡ 1 mod q_i, CRT-combine order-q_i elements).
Implement fast factorization of N (precomputed primes up to 31623, deterministic Miller–Rabin).
For each prime power q = p^e search a prime r = k·q + 1 (skipping used primes); find element a with ord_r(a) = q.
Handle N=1 (M=1) and provide single-prime fallback element-of-order-N path if the multi-prime product would exceed 1e18.
Verify the general construction path (brute-force order check for small N and random large N) — passed.
